oncall-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected — billing/metering: token_count drift on ingestion pipeline (prod). Alerting on-call: @matt-sre. Check runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/metering-emit-drift

matt-sre: Got it, looking. Any customer-facing impact?

janet-billing: We're seeing token counts higher than expected for 3 customers in EU region. Shadow tally +12-18% vs baseline since 02:10 UTC. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/metering/token-diff

olivia-cs: I'm on with support — one customer (acme-corp) got an overage flag email. They say it's 4x expected for last hour. Can we confirm?

matt-sre: Reproducing query now. Running quick aggregate: `SELECT sum(tokens) FROM usage WHERE ingest_ts > now()-1h GROUP BY customer_id LIMIT 5;` will paste results.

matt-sre: paste log snippet:
```
ingest: customer=acme-corp tokens=41234 expected=9800 source=proxy-3
ingest: customer=beta-inc tokens=12045 expected=10567 source=proxy-1
```

raj-ops: Noted. Looks like emitter batch window jumped — suspected duplicated ack replay from emitter service after a consumer restart. Rolling forward mitigation: enable ingress dedupe and pause emitter retries.

raj-ops: Command to toggle dedupe: `curl -XPOST https://ops-api/feature/ingest-dedupe -d '{"enabled":true}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>'` (will run in 30s)

matt-sre: Running dedupe toggle now.

matt-sre: Done. Monitoring counts.

janet-billing: Confirming counts in shadow: acme-corp delta down to +3% vs baseline after dedupe. Overage flags suppressed for known customers via temporary suppression rule id `suppress-6999`.

olivia-cs: I'll tell support to pause outreach for acme-corp and update them we're investigating. ETA?

matt-sre: ETA 15 minutes to validate backfill and prevent further overcounting.

leo-cs: Customer says they received two billing emails; support has paused notifications and requested credits if billable. Need reconciliation plan.

matt-sre: Creating follow-up ticket: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INC-699999

oncall-bot: Runbook step: "if token drift from emitter: enable ingest-dedupe, pause emitter retries, run reconcile job `reconcile/emit-fix --since 02:00`" Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/metering-emit-drift

raj-ops: I paused emitter retries at 6999991240. Also walled off the replay origin (proxy-3).

janet-billing: Starting manual recompute for affected window. Will post estimate for credits.

matt-sre: Handoff: I'll keep monitoring for the next hour, then hand to daytime SRE for postmortem. If anything customer-visible reappears ping me. Status: mitigated (ingest-dedupe enabled, emitter retries paused, suppression rule active). Closing pager.

olivia-cs: Thanks — please add timeline + impacted customers to the ticket.

matt-sre: Will do. /me pins runbook and ticket in thread.
